title: Domain Configuration
description: Schema-validated domain configuration envelope (PRD 'Domain configuration format: JSON, schema-validated'; sad.md §2 ADR-005). taxonomy/knowledge_base item shapes resolved by @system-arch in ADR-005 (keyword/section-scored retrieval, no vector store).

$schema.description: Self-reference to this schema file, e.g. './domain_config.schema.json'.

taxonomy.description: Intent/category taxonomy entries consumed by query_classifier and knowledge_retriever (sad.md §2 ADR-005).

knowledge_base.description: KB entries retrievable by knowledge_retriever via keyword/section-scored matching, floor 0.20, top 3 (sad.md §2 ADR-005). No vector store for MVP.

content.description: Groundable answer text returned to response_composer.

prompts.description: TODO(@backend.eng): prompt fragments templated into task descriptions/inputs. Shape undefined at scaffold time.
